modmailMentionsEnabled.label: Modmail Mentions: Enabled
modmailMentionsEnabled.helpText: Notify moderators via private message when they are mentioned in a modmail conversation.

modmailMentionsOnlyMods.label: Modmail Mentions: Only From Mods
modmailMentionsOnlyMods.helpText: Only send out notifications if the username mention is by another moderator. If you disable this, non-moderators will also be able to trigger notifications by mentioning a moderator in a modmail conversation.

modmailMentionsOnlyOnce.label: Modmail Mentions: Limit To One Mention
modmailMentionsOnlyOnce.helpText: Limit the number of notifications sent to a singular moderator to a maximum of one per modmail conversation.

modmailMentionsNoQuotes.label: Modmail Mentions: Ignore Quotes
modmailMentionsNoQuotes.helpText: Ignore any mentions that are inside a quote block.

modmailMentionsAllModsEnabled.label: Modmail Mentions: Notify All Mods Keyword Enabled
modmailMentionsAllModsEnabled.helpText: Lets a moderator alert the whole team at once by using one of the keywords below, instead of mentioning people individually. Off by default.

modmailMentionsAllModsKeywords.label: Modmail Mentions: Notify All Mods Keywords
modmailMentionsAllModsKeywords.helpText: Words that alert every moderator, separated by commas. Matched anywhere in the message and not case sensitive. Avoid short or common words, as any use of them will notify the whole team.

modmailMentionsAllModsLimit.label: Modmail Mentions: Notify All Mods Limit
modmailMentionsAllModsLimit.helpText: Safety limit. If more moderators than this would be notified, nobody is notified and a message is written to the app logs instead. Stops a very large mod team receiving a flood of messages.

modmailMentionsAllModsExcluded.label: Modmail Mentions: Notify All Mods Excluded Users
modmailMentionsAllModsExcluded.helpText: Moderators who should never receive these alerts, separated by commas. Useful for bot accounts. Do not include the u/ prefix.

highlighterEnabled.label: Auto-Highlighter: Enabled
highlighterEnabled.helpText: Automatically highlight important new modmail conversations.

highlighterAdmins.label: Auto-Highlighter: Highlight Modmails From Admins
highlighterAdmins.helpText: If enabled, new modmail conversations received from Reddit admins will be automatically highlighted.

highlighterContributors.label: Auto-Highlighter: Highlight Modmails From Contributors
highlighterContributors.helpText: If enabled, new conversations created by approved members aka contributors will be automatically highlighted.

highlighterNoSents.label: Auto-Highlighter: Don't Highlight Sent Modmails
highlighterNoSents.helpText: Modmail conversations initiated by the subreddit will not be highlighted, even if they match the other criteria.

highlighterNoAutoGens.label: Auto-Highlighter: Don't Highlight Auto-Generated Modmails
highlighterNoAutoGens.helpText: Automatically generated modmails will not be highlighted, this primarily means modmails generated by AutoModerator.

highlighterUsernames.label: Auto-Highlighter: Highlight Modmails From Specific Users
highlighterUsernames.helpText: Messages from these users will be highlighted. Please enter their usernames separated by commas, do not include the prefixes.

archiverEnabled.label: Auto-Archiver: Enabled
archiverEnabled.helpText: Automatically archive old modmails. If you disable this, you will still be able to manually run the archiver using a button in the subreddit menu.

archiveLastReplyUser.label: Auto-Archiver: Time To Archive If Last Reply Was By User (hours)
archiveLastReplyUser.helpText: If the last reply to a modmail conversation was by a user and it's older than this many hours, it will be archived.

archiveLastReplyMod.label: Auto-Archiver: Time To Archive If Last Reply Was By Mod (hours)
archiveLastReplyMod.helpText: If the last reply to a modmail conversation was by a moderator and it's older than this many hours, it will be archived.

archiveAutoGenerated.label: Auto-Archiver: Time To Archive Auto-Generated Modmails (hours)
archiveAutoGenerated.helpText: If the modmail conversation was automatically generated and has no mod replies, it will be archived if it's older than this many hours.
